title: Anti-blocking admission
description: Objective: enforce dependency necessity, approved-interface alternatives, semantic reduction, plan quality, and bounded blocker challenge before multi-node activation. Deliverable: scheduler admission modules with counterexamples. NOT in scope: execution dispatch or automatic graph rewrite. Hard dependencies: Dependency contract kernel. Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/admission/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Unnecessary hard edges are rejected or held with stable reasons.
Interface-first alternatives and intentional waits are represented without inventing readiness.
Admission is deterministic and never auto-removes a semantic edge.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.
